import unittest
from state import Job
from view import refresh
from actions import finish


class FlowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_finished_job_survives_refresh(self):
        job, widget = Job(), {}
        refresh(job, widget)
        self.assertTrue(widget['active'])
        finish(job, widget)
        self.assertFalse(widget['active'])
        refresh(job, widget)
        self.assertFalse(widget['active'])
        refresh(job, widget)
        self.assertFalse(widget['active'])

    def test_finish_updates_source(self):
        job, widget = Job(), {}
        finish(job, widget)
        self.assertEqual(job.status, 'completed')

    def test_other_jobs_keep_running(self):
        first, second = Job(), Job()
        finish(first, {})
        widget = {}
        refresh(second, widget)
        self.assertTrue(widget['active'])
